ranking.rule: eligible bucket >= 10.0% exclusive with a >= 5.0 percentage-point lead over the next eligible bucket

candidate_reason: no eligible G05 bucket reaches the 10.0% exclusive threshold with the required 5.0pp lead (framing 18.70% vs UTF-8 16.14% = 2.56pp). The remaining G05 work is spread across mandatory per-record validation: UTF-8 validation, STORED framing and bounds, modeled decode-budget admission, field-state/scalar dispatch and inlined bounds/overflow helpers. The source audit found no source-proven redundant work, and the selected-record bucket is effectively zero (2 samples), confirming that Phase 3's selectivity already works. A change would require removing or reordering mandatory validation, which is not authorized.
unsafe_techniques_not_authorized: skipping or short-circuiting validation of unselected records
treating a content digest as proof of semantic validity
persisting validation/offset metadata or adding a new on-disk section
changing modeled decode-budget semantics, check order or first-error precedence
reading only selected record bytes without a verified prior semantic validation mechanism
SIMD/unsafe validators, new dependencies or asynchronous remote reads

unselected_signals.absent_lane_column_setup: G03 (ColumnAccess::open / ColumnReader::open / read_u64_at) is 60.30% of the absent lane; the rare-primary rule does not select it
unselected_signals.medium_adapter_and_key_decode: G05 52.56%, adapter runtime 15.41%, legacy full DOC_KEYS decode 14.42%

limitations: process-wide CPU samples, including startup, warmups and JSONL transport; not elapsed time and not per-query stage durations
exclusive per-sample attribution only; inclusive shares are reported separately and never summed
one host, one session, synthetic frozen exact-term corpus; no cross-host, remote-latency or allocation claim
no new capture, no engine queries and no Rust test execution in P6F
no microseconds, speedup, QPS or memory savings may be inferred from sample percentages
